Mr Shakir Merali - Non Executive Director,
Maweni Limestone Limited

Mr Shakir Merali a graduate from London School of Economics, is a
seasoned Consultant and Investment Professional with over 20 years
experience in Developed and Emerging Markets. He has previously
worked with a range of companies, including Fortune 1000
corporations, multinational technology companies across Europe
and the United States and start up companies in emerging markets.
Mr Merali is now a partner at Aureos Capital in Nairobi and represents
Aureos Capital on the ARM subsidiary, Maweni Limestone Limited’s
Board.
